title.narrative: Participation of the civil society in mitigation of the climate change in Karaganda Oblast of Kazakhstan

description.narrative: The overall objective is to increase participation of the civil society in tackling climate change in Karaganda Region in order to contribute to Kazakhstan's achievement of the Paris Agreement goals. Specific objectives: 1) to develop the Climate Change Adaptation Strategy for Karaganda Region; 2) to improve access of the citizens to information on climate change and decision-making; 3) to establish cooperation between the state, civil society and business on adaptation and mitigation.
